judge-decisions-by-process.note: The inherited article mixed unsupported decision-quality effects with invented timing and memory thresholds, fabricated first-party results, arbitrary scores, and emotional-regulation instructions. The effective public record is narrowed to reconstructing what was actually known at the decision point, separating later information, inspecting concrete process strengths and omissions, and carrying one process improvement into the next similar decision.

qa-clear-feedback-templates.note: The inherited QA article contained fabricated engineering results, unsupported cycle-time reductions, pseudo-optimal evidence quantities, invented social effects, and universal prescriptions. The effective public record is a defect-reporting handoff: observable behavior, relevant context, reliable reproduction information, focused redacted diagnostics, explicitly labeled hypotheses, expected behavior, and a narrow acceptance check.

creativity-within-constraints.note: The inherited creativity article included unsupported mechanisms, fabricated output comparisons and observations, physiological engagement claims, pseudo-optimal session lengths, and arbitrary completion targets. The effective public record treats a constraint only as a reversible way to generate a different draft: constrain one dimension, create a variant, and keep only changes that improve the actual brief.

daily-priority-review-coach.note: The inherited task-review article contained fabricated cohorts and retention results, unsupported time-savings, arbitrary review durations and archival thresholds, and pseudo-optimized task counts. The effective public record is a task-list maintenance workflow: scan the active horizon, close or park stale work, clarify next actions and blockers, choose a small current attention set, and stop before review becomes execution.
